chunks: May Allah grant us and you success in what pleases Him, and peace.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Imam Ali's supplication for success in pleasing Allah?
ai.summary: This concise closing supplication from Imam Ali (AS) to the governor of Mecca emphasizes divine assistance in achieving *mahabbat* (that which is loved/pleasing to God), reflecting the Shia emphasis on aligning human action with divine will. It serves as a spiritual reminder to the administrative leader that political authority is validated by spiritual success. The brevity of the phrase underscores the directness of the Imam's communication style in official correspondence.
